title: Check if Bitwise OR Has Trailing Zeros
summary: Given an array of positive integers, determine if selecting two or more elements results in a bitwise OR with at least one trailing zero in its binary representation.
statement: Given an array of positive integers, determine if selecting two or more elements results in a bitwise OR with at least one trailing zero in its binary representation. Return true if possible, otherwise return false.
constraints: Their bitwise OR has a trailing zero exactly when its least-significant bit is zero.
Return whether at least one qualifying pair exists.
reference_solution:
def has_pair_or_with_trailing_zero(nums):
    return sum(value%2==0 for value in nums)>=2
hints: An OR bit is zero only when that bit is zero in both operands.
The trailing bit is zero exactly for even integers.
Therefore test whether nums contains at least two even elements.
Two evens are sufficient, and any qualifying pair must consist of two evens, proving equivalence.
editorial: Two evens are sufficient, and any qualifying pair must consist of two evens, proving equivalence.

tests.explanation: The even values two and four have an even OR, so a qualifying pair exists.
Any pair of these even values has a trailing zero.
